extensionDescription.message: Save academic documents, metadata, collections, and tags directly to your local Nodus Library.

detectingHint.message: Reading only the active tab after your click.

connectHint.message: Open Nodus and enable the Chrome connector in Settings → Integrations. This browser connects automatically.

cannotReachNodus.message: Nodus could not be reached on port $PORT$. Open Nodus and use the port shown in Settings → Integrations.

webSnapshotHint.message: Keep a local copy of this page with the reference.

unsupportedPage.message: Open a regular web page or document (HTTP/HTTPS), then click the Nodus icon again.

enableInNodus.message: Enable Nodus Research Connector in Nodus → Settings → Integrations first.

libraryNotReady.message: Choose a backup folder in Nodus first so the local nodus-library folder can be created.

portHint.message: Use the port shown in Nodus → Settings → Integrations.

pairingForgotten.message: Local connection reset. The connector will reconnect automatically next time.

authorsHint.message: One author per line; use {Organization} for institutions

signInPageInsteadOfPdf.message: $NAME$: the site returned a sign-in page instead of the PDF.

fileExceedsLimit.message: $NAME$: the file exceeds the 64 MiB limit.

backgroundTransferNoResult.message: The attachment transfer in the background did not return a result.

privacyLocalBody.message: Nodus Research Connector reads a page only after you click its toolbar icon. It sends the metadata, selected files, tags, and collection choice to the Nodus desktop application on your own computer through 127.0.0.1.

privacyNoTrackingBody.message: It does not run continuously, collect browsing history, use analytics, show advertising, sell data, or send captured content to Nodus developers.

privacySiteAccessBody.message: If Nodus cannot download a selected attachment publicly, Chrome can ask for access to that exact website so an on-demand service worker can transfer it locally. Newly granted access is revoked when the transfer finishes. You can also reset the Nodus pairing from this extension's settings.

jobContinues.message: Saving continues after you close this window.
